content.short: Highlight is a no-code NFT minting and collection management platform enabling creators to launch NFT projects on Mantle without writing code.
content.description: Highlight is a creator-focused platform that simplifies NFT collection launches with a no-code interface supporting multiple blockchain networks including Mantle. Artists and brands can design, deploy, and manage NFT collections  including generative art drops, editions, and membership passes  without any smart contract coding knowledge. Highlight handles the technical complexity of on-chain deployment, metadata hosting, and mint site creation, allowing creators to focus entirely on their art and community.
content.meta: Highlight is a no-code NFT minting platform for creators launching collections on Mantle without coding. Discover Highlight on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
